Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding disclosure of political contributions by persons awarded sole source state contracts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disclosure of political contributions by personsawarded sole source state contracts; and adding a new section tochapter 42.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person or business entity that is awarded a sole sourcecontract from a state agency of twentyfive thousand dollars or more,or two or more contracts totaling twentyfive thousand dollars in theaggregate in a twelvemonth period, must file a report with thecommission detailing contributions made in the twelve months before thecontract award. The report must: (a) Include an itemized list of the contributions made to acandidate or holder of a state office, a caucus political committee, ora bona fide political party by the contract recipient, a principalassociated with the contract recipient, including a subcontractor orconsultant, a spouse or registered domestic partner of a principal, ora political committee sponsored by the recipient or a principal of thecontract recipient; and p. 1 HB 2700 (b) Be filed no later than fifteen days after the signing of thecontract. (2) The commission shall post on its web site information regardingpolitical contributions made by persons awarded sole source contractsof twentyfive thousand dollars or more. (3) A state agency that awards a sole source contract of twentyfive thousand dollars or more, or two or more contracts to the samecontractor that totals twentyfive thousand dollars or more in theaggregate, shall, no later than five days after the date of thecontract award, notify the commission of the name and street address,city, state, and zip code of the recipient, the amount of the award,and a description of the contract. (4) For purposes of this section, sole source contracts includecontracts for goods and services awarded under chapter 43.19 RCW,personal service contracts under chapter 39.29 RCW, or public workscontracts under chapter 39.04 RCW. Contracts awarded under exemptionsdue to declared emergencies as provided by law are exempt from thissection. (5) For purposes of this section, "sponsored by" means any personwho alone or in conjunction with other persons makes, directs, orauthorizes contributions, expenditures, or strategic or policydecisions on behalf of the committee.
